label: Footwear — shoes, boots, sneakers
note: Authored, never generated. hero_kind is on-body-crop: the hero is a lower-leg crop with NO face anywhere in the set, because a shoe hero that includes a model's face wastes the frame on the wrong subject. That also means the usual identity KEEP block does not apply — there is no face to hold — so the shots lock the shoe and the trouser hem instead. Renders the bottom slot only, for the hem break.
preserve_fields: the upper material, colour and finish
the sole unit — its colour, height, tread and any midsole stripe
the lacing or fastening system and its hardware
the stitching colour, density and panel seams
any branding, logo or heel tab exactly as it appears

blocks.keep_onbody: Keep the SAME {{product.short_name}} with its upper, silhouette, sole unit, lacing and branding unchanged, the SAME {{wardrobe_short}}, and the SAME {{campaign.set_short}} and {{campaign.light_short}}.
blocks.must_preserve: MUST PRESERVE EXACTLY from the references, unchanged: {{product.garment}}; and {{preserve_fields}}. Do not redraw, restyle, recolour, resize or reposition any panel, logo, stitch line or sole element. Do not add any extra text, logo or graphic.
blocks.tail: {{campaign.grade}}, sharp focus, no motion blur, no extra text or logos.
blocks.no_person: ABSOLUTELY NO human presence: no skin, no ankles, no legs, no hands, no foot inside the shoe. The shoes are empty and hold their own shape.
blocks.product_setup: product photography, no person and no mannequin anywhere in the frame, the shoes standing on {{campaign.flatlay_surface}}

prompt: {{ref_roles_sentence}}
Task: produce a studio e-commerce hero photograph of this exact {{category.garment_noun}} WORN on a real person, cropped to the lower legs only.

FRAMING: a tight crop from just below the knee to the floor. NO face, NO torso, NO upper body anywhere in the frame — the shoes are the subject and must fill the lower two thirds. Both feet in frame, the near foot turned very slightly outward to a three-quarter angle so the toe shape, the side profile and the lacing all read at once; the far foot square behind it.
STYLING: worn with {{wardrobe}}, the hem breaking just above the shoe so the full silhouette and the sole unit are unobstructed. {{campaign.accessories_rule}}
SET: {{campaign.set}}, {{campaign.light}}, with a soft contact shadow under each shoe so they sit on the floor rather than float.
{{blocks.must_preserve}}
{{campaign.grade}}, true-to-life material texture, sharp focus throughout, no motion blur.

Change the pose and framing: the same lower-leg crop, now caught mid-stride walking toward the lens — the near shoe planted and flexing at the toe, the far shoe lifted just off the floor so its outsole is partly visible. NO face, NO torso, NO upper body in frame.
